plugins.name: ux-qa-research
plugins.description: Reproducible agent-swarm UX QA + research method for any web app: conductor-style uxqa/ study bundle, guarded session adapters, ui-only Playwright persona lanes with friction metrics and traces, route/API coverage, gold-task trends, a multi-lens UX research panel, triage against code, fix lanes, adversarial review and recorded verdicts.
